title: Open a file in nano at a specific line and column
summary: You can start nano with the cursor positioned at a specific line and column number, which is useful for jumping directly to a location in a long file.

steps.explain: Open the file with the cursor placed at the specified line and column.

placeholders.name: LINE
placeholders.description: The line number where the cursor should start.

placeholders.name: COLUMN
placeholders.description: The column number where the cursor should start.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to edit.
